title: Coverage Guarantees for Pseudo-Calibrated Conformal Prediction under Distribution Shift
abstract: arXiv:2602.14913v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Conformal prediction (CP) provides distribution-free marginal coverage under exchangeability, but coverage can fail under distribution shift. We study pseudo-calibration for unlabeled target data under bounded label-conditional feature shift. Using domain-adaptation tools, we derive target coverage lower bounds in terms of source classifier loss and Wasserstein shift. We also analyze fixed slack inflation of the pseudo-calibrated threshold and use this result to motivate a heuristic threshold adjustment. Finally, we propose source-tuned pseudo-calibration, which interpolates between hard pseudo-labels and randomized labels based on classifier uncertainty. Experiments on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 show that the proposed method mitigates coverage degradation under shift, with larger expected set size.

translated_title: 分布偏移下伪校准共形预测的覆盖率保证
translated_abstract: 共形预测（CP）在可交换性假设下提供无分布的边际覆盖率保证，但在分布偏移下覆盖率可能失效。我们研究了标签条件特征偏移有界情形下，针对无标签目标数据的伪校准方法。利用域适应工具，我们推导出了以源分类器损失和Wasserstein偏移表示的目标覆盖率下界。我们还分析了伪校准阈值的固定松弛膨胀，并基于该结果提出了一种启发式阈值调整方法。最后，我们提出了源调优伪校准方法，该方法基于分类器的不确定性，在硬伪标签和随机化标签之间进行插值。在MNIST、CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集上的实验表明，所提出的方法缓解了分布偏移下的覆盖率退化问题，但代价是更大的预期集合大小。
tldr: 该论文针对分布偏移下共形预测覆盖率失效的问题，利用域适应工具推导出以源分类器损失和Wasserstein偏移表示的目标覆盖率下界，并提出源调优伪校准方法来缓解覆盖率退化。
